versions.content: AUTOSAR COM Module The COM module manages signal packing/unpacking, transfer properties (Triggered, Pending), signal groups, filter algorithms, and interaction with the PDU Router. function Com_SendSignal [SWS_CP_COM_00001] uint8 Com_SendSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId, const void* SignalDataPtr); Updates the value of a signal in the transmission I-PDU buffer. If the transfer property is TRIGGERED, it schedules or initiates transmission through PduR. function Com_ReceiveSignal [SWS_CP_COM_00002] uint8 Com_ReceiveSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId, void* SignalDataPtr); Retrieves the latest received and unpacked value of a signal from the receive I-PDU buffer. function Com_SendSignalGroup [SWS_CP_COM_00003] uint8 Com_SendSignalGroup(Com_SignalGroupIdType SignalGroupId); Atomically copies group shadow signals into the transmit I-PDU buffer to ensure data consistency across multiple grouped signals. function Com_ReceiveSignalGroup [SWS_CP_COM_00004] uint8 Com_ReceiveSignalGroup(Com_SignalGroupIdType SignalGroupId); Atomically copies all group signals from the receive I-PDU buffer to shadow buffers for consistent reading by the application. function Com_TriggerIPDUSend [SWS_CP_COM_00005] Std_ReturnType Com_TriggerIPDUSend(PduIdType PduId); Triggers immediate transmission of the specified I-PDU without waiting for cyclic timers. function Com_Init [SWS_CP_COM_00006] void Com_Init(const Com_ConfigType* config); Initializes the internal signal tables, IPDU buffers, default signal values, and deadline monitoring timers. function Com_MainFunctionRx [SWS_CP_COM_00007] void Com_MainFunctionRx(void); Cyclic task processing deferred reception indications, signal filtering, and reception deadline monitoring. function Com_MainFunctionTx [SWS_CP_COM_00008] void Com_MainFunctionTx(void); Cyclic task executing periodic transmission of cyclic I-PDUs and decrementing transmission timers. PDU Router (PduR) The PDU Router routes I-PDUs between communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet) and upper layer modules (COM, DCM, SecOC). function PduR_ComTransmit [SWS_CP_COM_00010] Std_ReturnType PduR_ComTransmit(PduIdType TxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Routes a transmission request from COM to the configured destination bus interface (e.g. CanIf_Transmit, EthIf_Transmit). function PduR_CanIfRxIndication [SWS_CP_COM_00011] void PduR_CanIfRxIndication(PduIdType RxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Handles received frame indication from CanIf and forwards the I-PDU to COM or DCM according to routing tables.
